metadata.title: 2 Stock Sectors to Buy to Survive a Sinister September<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
2 Stock Sectors to Buy to Survive a Sinister September
It’s no surprise that many sectors typically drop in the fall, given that September is notoriously a rough month for the entire market. But that means investors who shop carefully can find some rewarding bargains.
